description: Convert and inspect Unix timestamps and dates. Operations: "to-date" — Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds) to a full date breakdown.; "parse-date" — Auto-detect and parse a date/timestamp string.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: to-date returns a different result on each call.

input.description: to-date: The Unix timestamp in seconds. parse-date: A date or timestamp string (ISO 8601, RFC 2822, Unix, etc.).

operation.description: to-date — Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds) to a full date breakdown. parse-date — Auto-detect and parse a date/timestamp string.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: timestamp
title: Unix Timestamp Converter
